confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from Da Nang travel guides and listing sites dated March to October 2026, with local prices converted at roughly 26,000 VND per USD. Coffee, beer and restaurant meal anchors have moderate support. Cocktail and wine anchors rest on thinner, mid-range bar and restaurant ranges and were cross-checked against the local beer relationship, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season from general knowledge; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. FX is stale: the latest RBA observation for 2026-11-19 could not be retrieved, so the fx block is the most recent RBA value I could trace (2026-03-20) and should be refreshed before use. An unverified third-party figure dated 2026-10-27 was not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Da Nang-specific guide and listing data. Cocktail and wine are benchmarked to local beer prices. Accommodation reflects general Southeast Asian beach-city hotel tiers rather than a named comparable city.
